correctness.rationale: The two seam scan equations and internal equations are equivalent to a 26-state deterministic endpoint-predecessor automaton. A regenerated transition table counts distinct outputs by terminal bit weights. Exactly 26 consecutive residuals of the order-five recurrence vanish in an integer table of dimension 26, so Cayley--Hamilton proves the recurrence for all lengths. The numerator and entropy follow algebraically. Independent exhaustive simulation through n=16, with full independent reachability testing through n=13, agrees.
